Overview

Aalst is a city in East Flanders with a population of 88,000. Famous for its irreverent Carnival parade (UNESCO-listed), this East Flemish city offers affordable housing and a strong sense of local identity. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
